tasks.label: Build All (Plugins + Binaries)
tasks.command: rm -f mrapps/*.so main/mrworker main/mrcoordinator main/mrsequential && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/wc.so mrapps/wc.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/indexer.so mrapps/indexer.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/mtiming.so mrapps/mtiming.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/rtiming.so mrapps/rtiming.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/jobcount.so mrapps/jobcount.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/early_exit.so mrapps/early_exit.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/crash.so mrapps/crash.go && go build -race -buildmode=plugin -o mrapps/nocrash.so mrapps/nocrash.go && go build -race -o main/mrworker main/mrworker.go && go build -race -o main/mrcoordinator main/mrcoordinator.go && go build -race -o main/mrsequential main/mrsequential.go
